LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeCureDesc: Target a living patient - the Grandmaster included - and cure one pathological condition: diseases, chronic illness, food poisoning. Wounds, missing parts, implants, pregnancy and unknown conditions are never offered.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeReconstructDesc: Target a living patient and restore one missing natural body part. A part already replaced by a bionic, prosthetic or implant is never offered. A Grandmaster can rebuild their own body only with enough working hands.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeResuscitateDesc: Target a recently dead, medically viable corpse and bring the pawn back to life. The brain must be intact, the body fresh, and the work must begin within four hours of death. Destroyed vital organs are rebuilt only as far as life requires; lost limbs stay lost. Wounds are preserved and stabilised, and the worst of the death trauma leaves permanent scars. A hostile pawn stays hostile.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeCost: Needs {0} medicine potency (one industrial medicine is 1, herbal 0.6, glitterworld 1.6; stacks combine) and about {1} of this Grandmaster's work. The patient's medical care setting limits which medicine is used.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotPractising: {0} cannot practise Grandmaster medicine right now (needs consciousness and manipulation).
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotOurPatient: {0} is not under the colony's care. Only colony members, prisoners of the colony, or downed pawns can be treated.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoCureCandidates: {0} has no condition Grandmaster Cure can safely address. Wounds are treated by ordinary tending; missing parts by Reconstruct.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoReconstructCandidates: {0} has no missing natural anatomy that can be reconstructed.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_SelfReconstructHands: {0} needs at least {1} manipulation to reconstruct their own body.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotEnoughMedicine: Not enough permitted medicine: this intervention needs {0} medicine potency, {1} available. Check the patient's medical care setting and forbidden medicine.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_MedicineTooScattered: The medicine for this is spread over more than {0} stacks. Gather it into fewer stacks first.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ConditionGone: The condition is no longer present.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoLongerCurable: {0} is no longer a condition Grandmaster Cure can address.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoLongerReconstructable: The body part can no longer be safely reconstructed.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResUnavailable: This body cannot be reached for resuscitation.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResNotFlesh: Only flesh bodies can be resuscitated.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResSupernatural: This is not a medical death.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResBrain: Brain destroyed. What carried the mind is gone, and cannot be rebuilt.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResVital: Vital anatomy destroyed beyond what a minimal reconstruction can safely rebuild.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResHostileWarning:
{0} will remain hostile after resuscitation.

The Grandmaster saves the life; nothing makes the patient grateful. Revived here, they will go straight back to fighting the colony.

Resuscitate anyway?
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResRebuilt: Rebuilt so that life was possible again: {0}.

LanguageData.GM21_Med_TreatmentImmunity: Grandmaster Treatment ({0}): immunity to this disease develops x{1} faster
